fields.description: Serve the storefront under this path, e.g. store gives /store, /store/products, /store/cart. Use it when the site already has its own website. Leave empty to serve the storefront from the site root, where the theme's home page becomes the site home page.
fields.label: Route Prefix
Customers Land in the Store
fields.description: After signing in or setting a password, customers go to their store account rather than the site's home page (the Customer role's home page), and Frappe's /me page sends them there too

fields.label: Catalogue Menu Label
fields.description: The name of the menu that lists the store's collections. Empty shows "Products"

fields.label: Allow Ordering Out of Stock Items

fields.description: Charged per order. Leave at zero for free shipping.
fields.label: Flat Shipping Rate

fields.description: Order value at which shipping becomes free.
fields.label: Free Shipping Above

fields.description: Income account used for the shipping charge on orders.
fields.label: Shipping Account
Duties and Import Fees
fields.description: For countries the store sends duties paid: the order pays the duty and the carrier's fees for it as one line, the duties item's

fields.label: Duties Item
fields.description: The order line the duties and fees are charged on, named as the item is, e.g. "Duties and Import Fees"
How customers can pay online at checkout, each with its own fee. Set up gateways such as Stripe or PayPal in Desk under Payment Gateway.
fields.label: Online Payment Gateways

fields.description: The store's own taxes, used when no Tax Rule marked "Use for Shopping Cart" matches an order. Set Tax Rules (e.g. by shipping country) for other taxes, such as zero-rated exports.
fields.label: Tax Template

fields.description: When set, shipping is charged as a line with this item, so the order's taxes apply to it
fields.label: Shipping Item
Weight Unit
fields.description: The unit product weights are entered in
Adds an online payment gateway's fee to the order as a line with this item. Leave empty for no fee
fields.label: Payment Fee Item

fields.description: Unpaid bank transfer orders are cancelled after this many days
fields.label: Days to Pay

fields.description: Charges the account's conversion fee on orders paid in another currency
fields.label: Currency Conversion Item

fields.description: Adds the account's transfer fee to bank transfer orders as a line with this item
fields.label: Transfer Fee Item

fields.description: When a bank reports the fee it took from a transfer, the fee is booked here on the Payment Entry
fields.label: Bank Charges Account

fields.description: Shoppers must accept the terms to create an account, apply for trade, place an order or accept a quote.
fields.label: Require Terms Acceptance

fields.description: Optional: an outside page with the terms. Leave empty to show the Terms and Conditions above on the store's terms page.
fields.label: Terms URL

fields.description: Optional second checkbox for business buyers, e.g. that consumer law does not apply
fields.label: Business Buyer Statement

fields.description: The ERPNext Terms and Conditions shoppers accept. They go on orders and quotations and print on them.
fields.label: Terms and Conditions

fields.description: Shown beside the checkbox, after "I accept the Terms and Conditions". Use it for points buyers must notice.
fields.label: Terms Checkbox Note

fields.description: Approved trade customers join this Customer Group (its Price List, Payment Terms, credit limit and Store Discounts apply). Applications arrive as Leads with UTM Source "Store Trade Application".
fields.label: Trade Customer Group
Allow Trade Applications
fields.description: Businesses can apply for a trade account from the storefront
Shoppers can ask for a quote at checkout instead of ordering. It arrives as a draft Quotation for staff to finish and send.
fields.label: Allow Quote Requests

fields.description: How long a quote made from a request stays valid.
fields.label: Quote Valid For (Days)
Staff Notification Emails
fields.description: Who is told of trade applications, quote requests and returns, one email per line. Empty: every Shop Manager and Sales Manager
Show product, cart and checkout prices with the tax of the store's Tax Template, and the price without tax under them.
fields.label: Show Prices With Tax

fields.description: Show prices in another currency with the store's tax, as for a buyer at home. Off, they are shown without it, as for a buyer abroad. Checkout always charges the tax for the delivery address, from the Tax Rules or the Export Tax Template.
fields.label: Show Other Currencies With Tax

fields.description: Taxes for orders shipped outside the company's country, when no Tax Rule for the shopping cart matches them.
fields.label: Export Tax Template

fields.description: The Sales Order naming series for store orders, e.g. a short one like SO-.##### so the order number fits a bank transfer reference. Add it to Sales Order in Document Naming Settings first. Empty uses ERPNext's default.
fields.label: Order Naming Series
Delivery Days
fields.description: The delivery date a store or quote order gets, this many days after it is placed
Make and submit the Sales Invoice when an order is paid in full, and email it to the customer.
fields.label: Invoice Paid Orders

fields.description: Email the customer when their order ships and when it is delivered.
fields.label: Email Shipping Updates

fields.description: Cancel online and bank transfer orders that are not paid by their due date, and tell the customer.
fields.label: Cancel Unpaid Orders

fields.description: Email a customer who left the payment page this many hours after the order. 0 sends no reminder.
fields.label: Remind Unpaid Online Orders After (Hours)
Remind Left Carts After (Hours)
fields.description: Email a shopper who left items in their cart this many hours later, once. 0 sends no reminder; check your country's rules on marketing email first.
Days after an order ships that the customer can ask for a return or replacement from their order page. 0 turns this off.
fields.label: Return Window (Days)

fields.description: Email each customer in the trade Customer Group a statement every month, with ERPNext's Process Statement Of Accounts.
fields.label: Email Monthly Statements

fields.description: The warehouses the store sells from, first to last: an order takes each item's stock from the first warehouse that has it, and is sent from each warehouse by its provider, one parcel per warehouse.
fields.label: Fulfillment Locations
